name: seo-geo-ai-search-readiness-auditor
title: Technical SEO, Schema.org & AI Search (GEO / llms.txt) Auditor
description: Audits websites for both traditional Google SEO and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO / AI Search: ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini). Checks Title, Meta, Canonical, H1/H2 hierarchy, missing image alt tags, Schema.org JSON-LD types, sitemap.xml, /llms.txt, and robots.txt AI crawler permissions (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot).
